eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Siskiyou, CA; at 8:45 PM on AUG 19, 2023 Effective until 2:15 AM AUG 20, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
An evacuation order has been issued for Zone SIS-1301 North West of Highway 96 near Cottage Grove. Anyone currently in this area is ordered to immediately evacuate.

visit protect.genasys.com for the current evacuation statuses for Zones throughout Siskiyou County.
